content.title: Fubo TV Reaches Deal With Spectrum SportsNet LA To Stream Dodgers Games
content.text: Originally posted on Dodger Blue | By Blake Williams | Last updated Mar 27, 2026 1:05 PM ET FuboTV Inc. and Spectrum SportsNet LA announced an agreement that brings the Los Angeles Dodgers to Fubo’s live TV streaming platform for the start of the 2026 Major League Baseball season. Announced just before Opening Day, SportsNet LA’s coverage of every available Dodgers game, including pre- and postgame shows and exclusive content, became available on the streaming platform. At launch, SportsNet LA is available to FuboTV base plan subscribers in the SportsNet LA footprint. SportsNet LA is the exclusive 24/7 TV home of the Dodgers, taking fans behind the scenes and offering in-depth access to the organization, providing an immersive experience with never-before-seen content and thousands of hours of comprehensive Dodgers programming. For the 2026 season, SportsNet LA will televise more than 140 regular season games, beginning with Friday’s home game against the Arizona Diamondbacks, which will feature the team’s 2025 World Series ring ceremony. First pitch for that game is scheduled for 7:10, with pregame coverage beginning at 6 p.m. Throughout the season, viewers will also see the network’s signature series, Backstage: Dodgers, which gives fans an exclusive look at their favorite team. Backstage: Dodgers will debut a special episode to kick off their season coverage on Friday. The season premiere features the team’s first full meeting and Spring Training at Camelback Ranch, with new additions Edwin Diaz and Kyle Tucker mic’d up as they settle in. Roki Sasaki also reflects on the challenges of his rookie season and his postseason turnaround. Fubo’s sports offering includes thousands of live sporting events annually, with many streaming in 4K, and more regional sports networks in its base package. Fubo also streams extensive Major League Baseball coverage, carrying MLB.TV, MLB Network, MLB Strike Zone, regional sports and broadcast networks, local broadcast networks and national sports networks ESPN and FS1. In addition to its sports coverage, Fubo also streams popular live entertainment and news programming and features more than 40,000 TV shows and movies on-demand each month. What is Fubo TV? Fubo is a live TV streaming company that offers premium sports, news, and entertainment programming through a service that aims to provide greater choice, flexibility, and value. The service is available for a free trial on their website with no commitment to the service. The sixth largest Pay TV company in the U.S. and ranked among The Americas’ Fastest-Growing Companies 2025 by the Financial Times, FuboTV Inc. owns Hulu + Live TV (entertainment), Fubo (sports) and Molotov (entertainment and sports), which stream in markets around the globe. FuboTV Inc. is an affiliate of The Walt Disney Company.
